newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex falls on profit forecast revision.
newsitem.headline: Budimex falls on profit forecast revision.

text.p: Polish construction firm Budimex SA on Monday fell the daily maximum 10 percent for the second session running to 22 zlotys on Thursday's news it had revised down its 1997 pre-tax profit forecasts, traders said.

On Thursday Budimex said it had revised down its 1997 group pre-tax profit forecast to 23 million zlotys from the 33.7 million given at the start of year and parent pre-tax to 15 million zlotys from 25.7 million.
Budimex said the revision was in part due to a downturn of the business cycle on the German and Czech markets and limited sales in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS). @
The firm said it did not expect any significant improvement on those markets in the second half and would seek to minimize effects of the slow-down.
For the second straight session on Monday the stock did not trade after price-fixing due to excess supply.
